$why: The note si-author receives when si-review rejected its previous instructions. A fragment, rendered by
lib/assistant-instructions.js into si-author's __CORRECTIVE__ slot — the words live here, not in code.
description: The reviewer's findings, handed back to si-author on a re-author.
body:
# Your previous instructions were rejected

The reviewer checked them and found the defects below. Write the instructions again: fix every blocking finding, fix an advisory one where it is right, and change nothing the findings do not touch.

__FINDINGS__
